summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and SHACLPathError (direct Exception subclass). Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture and a parametrized test covering valid forms (IRI, sequence, nested sequence, inverse, alternative, nested alternative, zero-or-more, one-or-more, zero-or-one, modifier of inverse, combined sequence) and invalid cases (rdf:nil path, empty sequence, one-item sequence, empty alternative, one-item alternative, unrecognized blank node, literal, rdf:nil as sequence item), plus checks for non-node inputs and the exception hierarchy. Each test asserts the shapes graph is unchanged. Result: test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py and test/test_path.py pass (42 tests) under the prepared venv. Not verified: black, isort, ruff, and mypy are not installed in the venv, so formatting was checked by hand (no lines over 88 characters). Nothing committed; only the two new files were added.
